parsed.explanation: Tier-1 universal exposure: Feb 2026 law restricts trans visitors to birth-sex facilities in public buildings including airports, schools and offices, with civil/criminal penalties to $1,000 and bounty suits by any private person - enforcement does not need police/prosecutor. Nationally, passport-marker restrictions, entry fraud scrutiny, a documented bathroom-trespass arrest with 24h men's-ward detention, and birth-sex custody conversion-therapy/hormone-removal policies show remedy failure. State anti-discrimination law since 2020 and national hate-crime cover do not offset the operative facility/document rule, and functioning courts have allowed it. Licence invalidation is mainly resident-facing, but signals active enforcement. No death penalty or organised sweeps documented, placing this at severe-unremedied-exclusion level, not 0.15/0.25 targeting.
